name: mcp-color-picker
description: MCP App that displays an interactive color picker

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && cross-env INPUT=mcp-app.html vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.server.json -e "import { build } from 'esbuild'; build({ entryPoints: ['server.ts'], outdir: 'dist', platform: 'node', format: 'esm', bundle: true, external: ['@modelcontextprotocol/*', 'express', 'cors', 'zod'] }).catch(() => process.exit(1));" && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.server.json -e "import { build } from 'esbuild'; build({ entryPoints: ['main.ts'], outfile: 'dist/index.js', platform: 'node', format: 'esm', bundle: true, external: ['./server.js', '@modelcontextprotocol/*', 'express', 'cors', 'zod'], banner: { js: '#!/usr/bin/env node' } }).catch(() => process.exit(1));"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
